FIND: CHALLENGE C0007 and C0011. The current implementation of `prior_findings` correctly includes all members of prior equivalence classes. Deduplicating them would break the intended behavior of `TopK` suppression, which is designed to suppress findings more strongly if they have been discovered multiple times (up to `k` times).
FOLLOW: If deduplicated, a finding discovered 10 times would suppress a new similar finding exactly as much as a finding discovered 1 time. This violates the frequency-based suppression design.
ANALYSE: REJECTED. The proposed fixes in C0007 and C0011 would introduce a bug.

FOLLOW: Changing this to require all members to be similar would cause massive false-novelty inflation, as a single slightly-different member would make a known cluster appear novel.
ANALYSE: CONFIRMED. C0003 is incorrect.
FIX: N/A
